name: hooks-portability-ci
description: CI gate that runs shipped hook scripts through the real portability failure modes the audits found: bash 3.2 parse errors (;;& fallthrough, mapfile), GNU-only sed/grep constructs (\b word boundaries, lazy quantifiers), and string-form tool_input payloads that crash jq. Reports a summary and exits non-zero on any failure. Invoked on demand or wired into CI.
